items.stem: 1 mi = 1.61 km. A car does 111 km/h; a truck does 42 mi/h. Which is faster? Choose the answer that shows both speeds in one unit.
sol: Put both speeds in km/h. A mile is 1.61 km, so 42 × 1.61 = 67.62 km/h.
Compare in one unit: 111 > 67.62, so the car is faster.
The answer is A.
